title: Tunisian Date Tagine
description: A sweet and tangy dessert inspired by the rich flavors of Tunisian cuisine, featuring fresh dates and a hint of juicy sweetness.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the date juice, passion fruit juice, and Tunisian fruit.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the fruit is tender and the liquid has thickened.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature before serving.
